name: id
description: The ID of the table.

name: border
description: If set to `false`, remove separating borders from all rows.

name: lastRowBorder
description: If set to `false`, remove separating border from the last row.

name: rows
description: Array of table rows and cells.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for cells in table rows. If `html` is provided, the `text` argument will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for cells in table rows. If `html` is provided, the `text` argument will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: A visually hidden suffix added to the table cell.

params.name: header
params.description: Header text for cells in responsive table rows only.

params.name: href
params.description: If set, the table cell will become a link.

params.name: format
params.description: Specify format of a cell – `"numeric"` or `"string"`. Defaults to `"string"`

params.name: sortValue
params.description: Sort value text for cells in table rows.

params.name: colspan
params.description: Specify how many columns a cell spans.

params.name: rowspan
params.description: Specify how many rows a cell spans.

params.name: align
params.description: Specify the table cell alignment – `"left"`, `"centre"`, or `"right"`. Defaults to `"left"`

params.name: width
params.description: Specify the table cell width. You can pass any design system grid width here – for example, `"one-third"`, `"two-thirds"` or `"one-half"`.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the table cell.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the table cell.

name: head
description: Array of table head cells.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for table head cells. If `html` is provided, the `text` argument will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for table head cells. If `html` is provided, the `text` argument will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: A visually hidden suffix added to the table head cell.

params.name: href
params.description: If set, the table header will become a link for server-side table sorting. Use `sort` to set the column sort direction.

params.name: format
params.description: Specify format of a cell – `"numeric"` or `"string"`. Defaults to `"string"`

params.name: colspan
params.description: Specify how many columns a cell spans.

params.name: rowspan
params.description: Specify how many rows a cell spans.

params.name: align
params.description: Specify the table head cell alignment – `"left"`, `"centre"`, or `"right"`. Defaults to `"left"`

params.name: width
params.description: Specify the table head cell width. You can pass any design system grid width here – for example, `"one-third"`, `"two-thirds"` or `"one-half"`.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the table head cell.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the table head cell.

params.name: sort
params.description: The sort direction applied to the column using `aria-sort` – `"ascending"`, `"descending"`, `"none"` or `true`. To enable sorting without a default direction, set `sort` to `"none"` or `true`.

params.name: sortNext
params.description: The next sort direction applied to the column using `aria-sort` when clicked – `"ascending"` or `"descending"`. Defaults to `"ascending"`. If you set `sort` to `"ascending"`, `sortNext` defaults to `"descending"`.

name: caption
description: Caption text.

name: captionId
description: The ID of the table caption, and the `aria-labelledby` attribute in the scrolling container. Defaults to the `id` option suffixed with `"-caption"`. If neither are provided, the ID is generated from the caption text.

name: captionClasses
description: Classes for caption text size. Classes to add to the table caption, for example `"nhsuk-table__caption--l"`.

name: captionSize
description: Size of the caption – `"s"`, `"m"`, `"l"` or `"xl"`.

name: captionDescriptionText
description: Message made available to assistive technologies to describe that the table is sortable. Defaults to `"Column headers are sortable"`.

name: firstCellIsHeader
description: If set to `true`, first cell in table row will be a `th` instead of a `td`.

name: compact
description: If set to `true`, vertical padding will be reduced for table cells.

name: responsive
description: If set to `true`, responsive table classes will be applied.

name: scroll
description: If set to `true`, wrap a scrolling container around the table component. Scrolling tables require the `caption` and `captionId` options.

name: striped
description: If set to `true`, striped background colours will be applied to table rows.

name: variant
description: Optional variant of table. You can use only `"reverse"` or empty values with this option.

name: card
description: Can be used to wrap a card around the table component. If any of these options are present, a card will wrap around the table.

name: panel
description: If set to `true`, the table will render within a panel with a heading. Replaced by the `card` option.

name: panelClasses
description: Classes to add to the table panel. Replaced by the `card.classes` option.

name: heading
description: Heading text that displays above the table when `panel` is `true`. Replaced by the `card.heading` option.

name: headingLevel
description: Optional heading level for the table panel heading. Defaults to `3`. Replaced by the `card.headingLevel` option.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the table container.

name: tableClasses
description: Classes to add to the table element. Replaced by the `classes` option.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the table container.

name: ascendingText
description: Text for columns in ascending sort order, used to populate the `%{direction}` placeholder in `sortAnnouncementText`. Defaults to `"ascending"`.

name: descendingText
description: Text for columns in descending sort order, used to populate the `%{direction}` placeholder in `sortAnnouncementText`. Defaults to `"descending"`.

name: sortAnnouncementText
description: Announcement made to screen reader users when a table column has been sorted. The component will replace the `%{header}` placeholder with the column header, and the `%{direction}` placeholder with the `ascendingText` or `descendingText` option value.
